hero_signature: Two-column hero on a bone/white background. Left: rounded-2xl 4:3 friendly dentist+patient photo with a floating 'Trusted in [City] since [Year]' bone/90 backdrop-blur badge at top-left. Right: char-stagger Outfit headline (4xl-6xl, bold, navy) followed by a friendly subhead, a coral pill primary CTA paired with a navy-outlined secondary CTA, and a small slate footnote line about emergency slots + PPO insurance.

section_flow.notes: Fixed nav. Starts on a clean white background; once scrollY > 20 it gains a backdrop-blur + soft shadow. Navy brand wordmark + slate links + coral pill 'Book Appointment'. Mobile menu opens a full-width drawer with body scroll-lock.
Slate-50 narrow band with mint check, mint stars, and 'N+ years in [City]' separated by thin vertical dividers on desktop.
Six service tiles in a 3-col grid. Each card has an ice-blue rounded square icon chip, bold Outfit title, slate body. Cards lift -4px on hover with a soft shadow grow.
Three centered cards with a 16x16 ice-blue circular badge holding a big Outfit numeral (1/2/3), bold step title, slate body.
Slate-50 section with a mint quote glyph above an Outfit 2xl-4xl bold quote. Initial-in-ice-circle avatar + 'Name · Patient since [Year]' below.
Three team cards: square photo, Outfit name + role + bio, white card with hover-lift.
Top: Outfit 5xl title + plain-language subhead. Below: stacked FAQ accordions with + → × rotation. Below that: insurance-carrier card grid (4-up on desktop) and the office-hours card.
Centered Outfit 5xl title. Left: slate-50 form card with name/phone/email/date/time/reason/notes; coral pill submit. Right: map placeholder + clickable address/phone + office-hours list.
Navy background, slate-200 text. Brand + tagline (2/4 cols) + Quick Links + Contact (address, phone, email). Bottom bar: license # + © year + Instagram/Facebook/Accessibility links.

notable_features: Soft hover-lift cards (translateY -4px + shadow grow) on services and team
Coral pill primary CTA (rounded-full, scale-102 on hover) paired with a navy-outlined ghost CTA that inverts on hover
Floating 'Trusted in [City] since [Year]' badge over hero photo
Char-stagger Outfit headline with 0.025s per-character delay and prefers-reduced-motion fallback
Accordion FAQs with + → × rotation driven by Framer Motion AnimatePresence
Insurance-carrier card grid (4-up on desktop) rendering each PPO carrier as a navy bone-and-slate tile
Numbered 3-step process with circular ice-blue badges and Outfit numerals
Multi-page Next.js App Router (Home / Team / FAQ / Booking) — never SPA show/hide
5-color restraint: bone bg, navy text, coral primary, mint accent, ice for soft chips
motion_vocabulary: Reveal: opacity 0->1 + y 24->0 over 700ms with [0.22,1,0.36,1] easing, once-only on viewport-enter
Hero entrance: opacity 0->1 + y 24->0 over 700ms with the photo entering at 0s and the text column at 0.1s delay
Hero char-stagger: each headline character opacity 0->1 + y 8->0 over 400ms, 0.025s stagger, starting after 0.2s
Card hover-lift: translateY -4px + shadow grow over 300ms ease
Coral CTA hover: scale-102 + background darken over 200ms
FAQ accordion: + glyph rotate 0->45deg + AnimatePresence height auto + opacity 0->1 over 400ms
Navbar transition: pt/pb shrink + bg-white -> bg-white/95 backdrop-blur + soft shadow over 300ms on scrollY > 20
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce -> all transitions clamped to 0.01ms and char-stagger replaced with plain text
tailwind_extras_inline_css: .btn-coral (coral background, white text, 99px rounded pill, hover scales 1.02 and darkens). .form-input-bd (white background, 2px ice border, 0.75rem padding, focus->coral border with coral-tinted ring). .shadow-soft (0 8px 30px -10px rgba(30,58,138,0.1)). .hover-lift (translateY -4px + shadow grow on hover, 300ms ease). Tokens: --color-bone, --color-ice, --color-navy, --color-mint, --color-coral, --color-coral-hover, --color-slate-light, --font-display (Outfit), --font-sans (Inter). H1-H4 default to Outfit globally.
